action.startReview.hint: Opens the investigation of the claim.
action.requestInformation.hint: Pauses the review until the policyholder answers.
action.approve.hint: Sets the amount to be paid.
action.reject.hint: Closes the claim; the reason is sent to the policyholder.
banner.readOnly: Read-only profile: you can look but not change anything.
declare.title: Declare a claim
declare.subtitle: Business rules are checked here to guide you, then enforced by the API.
declare.circumstancesPlaceholder: What happened? Where, when, what damage?
declare.timeBar: Two-year time bar: a loss that occurred more than two years ago can no longer be claimed (French Insurance Code, art. L114-1).
declare.dateRequired: The date of loss is required.
declare.dateFuture: The date cannot be in the future.
declare.descriptionMin: Describe the loss in at least 10 characters.
analysis.title: AI file review
analysis.disabled: The AI assistant is not enabled on this environment (no API key). Everything else works normally; the README explains how to enable it.
analysis.refused: The model declined this review. The documents can be examined manually.
analysis.footer: Requested by {INTERPOLATION} on {INTERPOLATION_1} · {INTERPOLATION_2} document(s) · {INTERPOLATION_3} tokens · advisory only, a human decides.
analysis.intro: The assistant compares the declaration with the evidence (dates, places, circumstances, amounts) and backs every finding with a quote from the source page.
analysis.needDocument: Attach at least one document to run the review.
decision.title: Decision
decision.overLimit: Above it, a claims manager must approve.
decision.fourEyes: {START_TAG_STRONG}Four-eyes principle.{CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} You approved this claim: another manager must release the payment.
decision.managersOnly: Releasing payments is reserved for claims managers.
decision.none: No action available for your profile.
documents.title: Evidence
documents.limits: PDF, PNG, JPEG · 10 MB max · format checked on receipt
stepper.label: Claim progress
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of the claims portfolio, updated live.
dashboard.emptyFeed: Decisions made by your colleagues will appear here instantly.
dashboard.emptyFeedHint: Open a second tab with another profile to try it.
login.title: Insurance claims handling, {START_TAG_SPAN}live and explainable.{CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
login.lead: Declare, review, approve and settle insurance claims — with the safeguards of a real regulated business and an AI assistant that backs every finding with a source.
login.chooseHint: Each profile has different rights. No password: it's a demo.
login.waking: The demo API is not answering. It may be waking up: try again in a few seconds.
login.tip: Tip: open two tabs with two different profiles to watch decisions arrive live.
login.h1.title: Real business rules
login.h1.text: Delegated authority, four-eyes principle, two-year time bar, audit trail.
login.h2.title: Reliable realtime
login.h2.text: Every decision propagates instantly, through a transactional outbox and SignalR.
login.h3.title: Explainable AI
login.h3.text: The file review quotes the exact page of each document. A human decides.
login.h4.title: Verified quality
login.h4.text: Over 150 automated tests, architecture enforced by tests, published load tests.
error.policyNumber: The policy number must follow the format POL-000000.
error.futureDate: The date of loss cannot be in the future.
error.timeBarred: Time-barred: more than two years have passed (French Insurance Code, art. L114-1).
error.descriptionLength: The circumstances must be between 10 and 2000 characters.
error.claimedAmount: The claimed amount must be positive and below €1,000,000.
error.reason: A reason is required for this decision.
error.approvedAmount: The approved amount must be positive and cannot exceed the claimed amount.
error.approvalLimit: This amount exceeds your delegated authority: a claims manager must approve this claim.
error.fourEyes: Four-eyes principle: the person who approved a claim cannot release its payment.
error.actionForbidden: Your role does not allow this action.
error.transition: This action is not possible in the claim's current state.
error.concurrent: Someone else just changed this claim. Its new version is shown: check it before deciding.
error.documentFormat: Only PDF, PNG and JPEG are accepted (checked from the file content, not its name).
error.documentCount: The claim has reached the maximum number of documents.
error.documentNotFound: This document does not exist on this claim.
error.aiDisabled: The AI assistant is not configured on this environment.
error.noDocuments: Attach at least one document before asking for a review.
error.network: The API cannot be reached. Check your connection.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
